posture-rollup.summary: mitigation-to-technique map AND the mitigation implementation store in one file

entries.reason: implService.summarize() gives mitigations by status; the mitigation ranking by group reach is mitigation-level. Known numbers read PostureService.rollup since P2-08. Removed by E9.3 (plan:892); the ranking goes to E7.2 (plan:862).

Implementation-counts tile counts mitigations by status; the status map is passed through to the HTML report and XLSX export; mitigationsByTechnique feeds two Known lookups (average mitigations per technique, technique of the day). None counts techniques as implemented; Known numbers read PostureService.rollup since P2-08. Dashboard tiles fold into Home (plan:466,813).

Mitigation-level or export only (Addendum note 3): the status$ subscription repaints cells after a status write, the cell tooltip reads mitigationsByTechnique for its mitigation count, and bulkSetStatus keeps the ImplStatus signature. Since P2-16 the bulk set writes technique marks (TechniqueMarksService), never mitigation statuses; the status lens, the controls lens and impl= read PostureService (P2-14).
entries.removedBy: stays (mitigation-level or export only; P2-14 and P2-16 removed the folds)

entries.reason: Ranks mitigations to do next from the status map and techniquesByMitigation; mitigation-level; E7.2.

implService.summarize() gives mitigations by status; the recommended-mitigations list ranks not-yet-implemented mitigations through statusMap and techniquesByMitigation. Both mitigation-level; the split and the CSV Implemented column moved in P2-07. Report-panel becomes the ReportService UI (plan:447).

setStatus writes mitigation status by design; the roadmap and auto-roadmap score mitigations through getTechniquesForMitigation, techniquesByMitigation and the status map, including the per-mitigation uncovered count (any mapped mitigation implemented; Addendum note 4). Known numbers read PostureService.rollup since P2-08. E5.5 is the single which-mitigation-next ranker (plan:456).
Implementation data block: import, export and reset of the mitigation status map; mitigation-level exports by design.

Mitigation-level or export only (Addendum note 3): the drawer mitigation rows and the All-mitigations strip set the status of the mitigation the user clicks, and getMitigationsForTechnique lists mitigations without counting techniques. Since P2-16 the technique answer on a broad mitigation row is the posture badge with Confirm and Unconfirm, which write technique marks (TechniqueMarksService).
entries.removedBy: stays (mitigation-level or export only; P2-16 added the badge and Confirm)

entries.reason: Filters exported rules by implemented mitigation; does not count techniques; E6.2.

implStats counts the distinct mitigations of a tactic by status (mitigationsByTechnique plus status$). Mitigation-level; the Known count and the posture lines read PostureService.rollup since P2-08. Becomes TacticRollup on PostureService in E9.3 (plan:467,892).
Mitigation targets by reach; mitigation-level; E7.2.
Hypothetical projections: what marking a mitigation implemented would change. Not a statement of current posture; E7.2.
Filters exported rules by implemented mitigation; does not count techniques; E6.2.
The pure D16 breadth-guard rollup (P2-01) the adapters call: an implemented mitigation marks its techniques, full or partial. Part of the seam; 100% branch-gated in CI.

getControlStatus is a control-level aggregate of mitigation statuses (controls implemented (attested), plan:157,371): mitigation-level by design, not a technique count. E6.7 (Rate your posture, plan:849) revisits it.
Passes the status map to the CSV, XLSX, PNG and report exporters; mitigation-level exports by design.
The impl= mitigation-status filter: matches only through the ImplStatus type and a techniquesByMitigation lookup for the mitigation filter; it counts nothing.

Mitigation status table: each mitigation with its mapped parent count, from the status map passed in. Mitigation-level, counts no technique as implemented; the technique badge and the split moved to PostureService in P2-07. E9.1 retires html-report.service (plan:890).
PNG export; its heat=status colour uses the best-status fold over mitigationsByTechnique, which P2-14 routes through implViewFor or lists as a bounded export window (Addendum note 4). E9.1.

Mitigation-level or export only (Addendum note 3): the layer export (technique colour and comment through implViewFor since P2-14, per-mitigation attack-navi:mitStatuses metadata) and the exact restore of that metadata on import. Since P2-16 a foreign comment writes one technique mark per technique under layer:<name> (replaceSource), never a mitigation status.
entries.removedBy: stays (mitigation-level or export only; P2-16 removed the reverse rollup)

entries.reason: PostureService store adapters (P2-05): implementationAdapter and implView turn mitigation statuses into Covered marks over techniquesByMitigation with the D16 breadth guard. Part of the seam.

PostureService: the one place the mitigation status store and the mitigation-to-technique map are joined into one PostureState per technique (P2-05). Every other surface reads it; this file is what the rule protects.

XLSX export: Known mitigation-only sheets; the Impl Status (best) column follows the implViewFor every caller must pass (PostureService.implViewFor; ExportActionsService and the dashboard) since P2-14 (Addendum note 4). E9.1.

one-picker.summary: a component outside threat-profile-picker reads domain.groups AND searches by alias (aliases.some() or the alias join form)

entries.reason: The campaign timeline: builds its group colour map from groupsByTechnique and searches campaigns by name and alias to toggle the matrix campaign filter; it never chooses the threat profile. Matches no one-picker clause today (no domain.groups read); listed so any group list it grows stays an annotated exception. Owner-approved exception (section 10.4 item 8).

The software list: searches software by name, ATT&CK id and alias to toggle the matrix software filter; it holds no group picker. Matches no one-picker clause today (no domain.groups read); listed so any group list it grows stays an annotated exception. Owner-approved exception (section 10.4 item 8).
The Threat Intel feed actor list: searches actors (groups) by name and alias in the feed, not a profile picker. Owner-approved exception (section 10.4 item 8: the feed list).

The matrix group filter (Groups tab): searches the full group list by name, ATT&CK id and alias to toggle the matrix threat-group filter. Owner-approved exception (section 10.4 item 8: FilterService and threat-panel are the matrix group filter).

The universal search: scores groups by name, ATT&CK id and their aliases joined into one string ((g.aliases ?? []).join(" ")) next to techniques, software and campaigns, to open a result; it never chooses the threat profile. Caught by the alias join form (RP-F decision 12). Owner-approved exception (section 10.4 item 8).

The matrix group filter's state: the grp= URL param maps ATT&CK ids to STIX ids and back through domain.groups.find (an id lookup, no alias search); it holds no picker and never chooses the threat profile. Matches no one-picker clause today (no alias search); listed so any group search it grows stays an annotated exception. Owner-approved exception (section 10.4 item 8: FilterService and threat-panel are the matrix group filter).

picker-select.summary: a file outside threat-profile-picker calls selectGroup( or selectCampaign( (the picker's selection methods)

entries.reason: Its own browse handler happens to be named selectGroup: onGroupPicked, the handler of the shared picker's (groupSelected) output, calls it to open the actor's profile. It has no preset buttons or group list of its own, so it is not a second selection path; the picker is the only way to choose the actor.
entries.removedBy: stays (the handler of the picker output, not a rival selection path)
